tips.text: Farm the 2 Argon Crystals last, right before you craft; they vanish from inventory after about a day.
Do the Polymer and Ferrite grind first, Neural Sensors second and Argon last.
Do the Ferrite and Polymer counts from one mission type or with Nekros; casual star chart play will not get you there.
Build this one even if you own Stradavar Prime; owning the Prime does not skip it.
Expect an easy farm; the only bottleneck is the 8,000 Polymer Bundles.
